scope: Limited read-only review of gemini_SLIM_prior_and_native_value_review.md; no new literature search, source changes, candidate execution, FIT payload or fresh/TEST data read.
verdict: Retain the bounded common-input/noCR system question, with the claim corrections below. No new experiment or gate is requested.
retain: Existing local-linearization, shared-basis and NAND/MoE compute precedents substantially constrain novelty. Common tree/P/leaf-centered A8 input across selected heterogeneous experts is a concrete implementation property worth testing, not by itself a new mathematical contribution.
The same-function ordinary-loader/cache path, inclusive auxiliary/workspace accounting, legal replicas, early-address information and actual ECC/PE/FIFO ownership are necessary system comparisons.

SO64_pre is a material fixed control because shared output lifting can reduce bank and active work. Preserve actual-alpha latent premerge rounding and the weighted-slot hook, with no division by alpha.

Native service/PPA remains unresolved; resident EPYC service and construction-specific96.96us cannot establish either native superiority or a no-go theorem. The eight-operator passes establish no equivalence, complete coverage, wholemodel>=10% gain or publication success.

required_claim_corrections.correction: A bounded source review cannot establish global absence or novelty. Say that this review has not identified a demonstrated implementation/evaluation of the full specified combination; separate known components from the remaining measured system question.

Beating one feasible ordinary-loader upper schedule proves superiority only to that named implementation/schedule under its stated resources, not to the best legal ordinary implementation. Use a credible optimized named comparator and matched workload/cache/host resources, or an appropriately scoped bound. Address readiness also waits for route/tree/cache resolution and real resource scheduling; five tree dots are work, not a zero-time prefetch guarantee. m0 equality describes the chosen CPU-hit-only policy, not a universal lack of any compute-offload opportunity.

C need not show significantly better global generation quality. Compare the matched-quality latency/capacity frontier in the declared scope. A host-resident shared U can leave SO with one flash phase; algebraic factorization does not imply two NAND phases or compulsory extra external-memory traffic. Generation is outside the present GT gate. Leading MAC/storage counts do not prove timing or quality dominance.

Bound a veto to the adopted hardware point, legal policies and workload/cache scope. A valid shape/lifetime/resource contradiction, or a feasible strong comparator dominating an optimistic bound within that scope, can reject that point without proving all architectures impossible. Strict superiority for every m and every possible PE schedule is not a necessary general stopping rule.

A valid harmful first64-v1 quality band rejects only that frozen configuration/calibration/budget under its prespecified adjudication, not local-affine/shared-input algorithm families. A passing band supports only the necessary earliest-layer GT screen. No formal analytic impossibility proof is required to judge a direction insufficiently valuable; absence of such a proof is not an obligation to run all deferred work.

finite_disposition: Keep the currently authorized fixed C64 FIT unchanged. Any artifact/fresh-quality/control/hardware phase still needs its existing separate release. If the necessary quality screen passes, examine the finite matched ordinary-load/cache and fixed D/NL/SO frontier before broader claims; no new rank/basis/grid is implied.
